name: Enemy Posture System PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: PRIVATE TEST. Enemy Posture System 0.10.1 (LNK SESSION01 FIX01: LNK02+LNK03+LNK04+LNK07). Everything of 0.9.0 (Bokoblin posture, break/punish/Finish, enemy bars, Shield Attack parry +40, Link's bottom posture bar, hidden bottom action prompts) PLUS: Link's posture also rises when a Bokoblin really hits him unblocked (confirmed from the game's own damage: invulnerability timer + real life loss, attributed to that attacker); parries still give Link +0; recovery depends on Link's life (10/8/5/2 points/s) and is x1.5 while holding a real guard; Blue/Red/Black/Black-in-fury weigh differently (block 20/25/30/35, direct hit 30/35/40/45). Native damage, guard and guard break are unchanged; 100 is still visual only. Replaces 0.10.0, 0.9.0 and older versions of this mod (same ID): never load them together. Human Windows DX12 validation pending. FIX01 adds native damage-source capture, safe reaction-continuation gates and observational offensive-cycle diagnostics. Runtime validation remains pending.
